blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Philippine police are investigating a laptop found alongside images of child abuse at the former home of Meghan Markle’s estranged father, with “full results” expected in a week, Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) told AFP. Thomas Markle, whose daughter is married to Britain’s Prince Harry, had been living in Cebu until reportedly returning to the United States earlier this year. DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla told AFP the country planned to take “appropriate legal actions” against Markle — who has denied all claims of alleged offending — if sufficient evidence was found.
